commands.notes: G3: leaving out the content block keeps the document open and returns it (replaces -NoSave); with a block -Path is required and the file is saved and closed when the block ends. If the block throws, nothing is saved and a partial file is removed. Native save fails on content loss unless -AllowLoss (G4, on Save-OfficePdf).

commands.name: Open-OfficePdf

parameters.name: OutputPath

commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficePdf. Without a block it returns the live document (G3). Inside the block, existing-PDF commands (Add-OfficePdfStamp, Set-OfficePdfPage, Remove-OfficePdfPage, Set-OfficePdfMetadata, ...) bind -Document to the open document implicitly. Opening never restyles the document.

commands.name: Save-OfficePdf
commands.synopsis: Saves a live PDF document to its own path or a new one.

parameters.name: AllowLoss
parameters.notes: G4: native saves fail on loss unless accepted.

commands.notes: -Path optional: defaults to the path the document was created or opened with. -Open/-Show alias collapses to -Show; -UserPassword alias removed.

commands.notes: PdfDocument becomes IDisposable in 3.6 (design: lifecycle). Completes the New/Open/Save/Close set.
